A '''chapter house''' was located on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Bogden 3]], established by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] sometime prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. As of [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Du Mahn]] was the facility's administrator.

==History==
Occupied by a [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|clan]] of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this facility hosted the [[Soaring Hawkbat Clan]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|Siege of Saleucami]]. Awaiting transport back to the main academy in the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], the group's [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was delayed due to the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|battle]] that took place over the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]. Waiting patiently, the facility's administrator and the clan's [[Jedi instructor|instructor]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Du Mahn]], continued the Hawkbats' education, with the assistance of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Chase Piru]]. Their wait was interrupted when the damaged shuttle of Masters [[K'Kruhk]] and [[Sian Jeisel]] landed in the facility's courtyard. While their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] made repairs, the two Masters recuperated in the facility as the younglings prepared a great feast for the war-weary [[Jedi General/Legends|generals]].<ref name="SWDT" />

Following the feast, the clone troopers prepared to return to their repairs when they received [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] from the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]] on Coruscant. Raising their rifles, the troopers opened fire on the younglings as the Masters ignited their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and began to slay the traitorous clones. As Jeisel and Piru deflected [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts, the great [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] Master leaped to-and-fro cutting down troopers in a rage. As Master Mahn shepherded her students to the main entrance of the facility, she fell victim to the troopers fire. In a last ditch effort, Master Jeisel used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to trigger a trooper's [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] as K'Kruhk took the remaining students to the shuttle. As Jeisel and the remaining troopers died in the ensuing explosion, the facility's main building went up in flames. Master K'Kruhk flew off with the survivors, at a loss for the troopers' betrayal.<ref name="SWDT" />

Despite suffering damage during the execution of Order 66, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was able to salvage the property and later agreed to terms with the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]], allowing members of the guild to use the facilities as a training ground.<ref name="BHC" />

==Layout==
[[File:JeiselSacrifice-DarkTimes6.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Master [[Sian Jeisel]] destroys the facility's main entrance.]]

Consisting of four main buildings, the training facility was made out of a cream-colored stone with green tinted [[Window/Legends|windows]]. A stone landing pad sat outside the main building, a two story structure with a curving roof. Inside the spacious main building was a gathering hall that served as a dining area. Orange pillars curved down from the ceiling while a spiraling staircase led to kitchens and storage rooms. Colorful lanterns hung from the ceiling to illuminate the open room, while a wide, circular doorway led to the outside. In the rear of the building, another set of doors led out into a courtyard with benches and lamp posts.<ref name="SWDT" />

The training facilities surrounding the main building were all connected by single story hallways. Domed structures housed training facilities and dormitories, while an orange tower stood sentinel over the academy grounds. Most of the facilities remained intact following Order 66, though the main building's entrance was destroyed in the assault.<ref name="SWDT" /> The buildings were later used by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] for training exercises.<ref name="BHC" />
